themes.title: Local and Regional Dynamics in Right-Wing Electoral Strategy
themes.blurb: Right-wing political figures and parties continue to focus on local and regional issues, either through direct engagement with local authorities on specific policy challenges or by leveraging local sentiment against bureaucratic decisions. This reflects a strategy to build support from the grassroots and address community-level concerns.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: President Trump engages directly with a local NYC mayor to discuss urban affordability, and federal immigration crackdowns involve local police enforcement, showing how national policy intersects with local dynamics.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: A local majority successfully challenges a county director's decision to cut vocational education, highlighting strong community reactions to local policy changes that right-wing parties can champion.
